youtube.title: A POLITICAL AGENDA
youtube.summary: Nathan Smith is joined by former National MP Maurice Williamson and Family First chief executive Bob McCoskrie for this week's political panel. They challenge media coverage of Winston Peters’ comments on conversion practices and abortion, examine strategic voting under MMP, and question the growth of Auckland Council bureaucracy. The discussion also explores government spending, the role of the state and whether political debate is being shaped by selective reporting. youtube.title: DON BRASH & MATT ROBSON
youtube.summary: Paul Brennan discusses the election with former Reserve Bank governor and National Party leader Don Brash and former minister Matt Robson. They argue that productivity growth deserves far more attention, examine how wealth is created and whether billionaires contribute fairly and debate strategic voting under MMP. With the election race tight, they consider the possible balance of power and the challenges facing the next coalition government.
